business_summary: TOA Corporation production and sale of public and broadcasting, communication, and other information transmission equipment in Japan. The company offers megaphones, PA systems, wireless systems, emergency/commercial broadcasting equipment, conference and meeting hall systems, video and audio systems for schools, wired microphones, speakers, maintenance systems, network-type content distribution terminals, and other audio equipment. It also provides video equipment, including network camera systems, town recorders, coaxial cable camera systems, and dummy cameras; network broadcasting and communication systems comprising IP audio, voice network equipment, and IP communication systems, as well as announcement creator, network-based content distribution terminal, and multilingual broadcasting services. In addition, the company offers disaster prevention, security, public address system, sound, and communication system solutions. Further, the company engages in the production, sale, rental, design, and installation of audio and visual equipment and other electrical and electronic devices; planning, production, and sale of audio and video software; telecommunications business; and rental and management of performance halls and studios, as well as planning and management of musical events. TOA Corporation was founded in 1934 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.
